configurations.name: gwashub-dev-no-image-build
runtimeArgs: PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; export GWASHUB_STEP_RUNNER=docker MPLCONFIGDIR=/tmp/gwashub-mpl GWASHUB_WORKERS=4; .venv/bin/uvicorn gwashub_api.main:app --app-dir api --port 8000 & trap 'kill $!' EXIT; until curl -sf localhost:8000/api/health >/dev/null; do sleep 0.5; done; cd web && npx nuxt dev --port 3000
